name: The Shadowy Search Continues
summary: In Duskwood, you trace the journal from Madame Eva to Clerk Daltry in Darkshire. It came from the ruins of Sven Yorgen’s ransacked farmstead.

sections.title: Tracing the Binding
sections.body: Madame Eva found that the journal’s author was an outsider, though its binding came from Darkshire. Clerk Daltry sells blank ledgers and tomes to traveling scholars, spellcasters, and record-keepers. So you follow those local sales for a clue to the sinister trespasser in Duskwood’s groves.

sections.title: A Jittery Buyer
sections.body: Clerk Daltry remembers the sale, though many records pass through Darkshire’s town hall. About a month ago, a nervous traveler bought the blank book and gave no name. The furtive buyer kept glancing over his shoulder, leaving a clear impression on the clerk. Sven’s shadowy figure had walked openly among Darkshire’s citizens.

faq.q: Where did the mysterious book come from?
faq.answer: Madame Eva says the author was an outsider, but the book was bought in Darkshire. Clerk Daltry sells blank books and may remember who bought it.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva send you to Clerk Daltry?
faq.answer: Madame Eva found that the book’s binding and materials came from a local purchase. Clerk Daltry sells blank ledgers and journals to locals and traveling scholars.

faq.q: What does Clerk Daltry remember about the buyer?
faq.answer: Daltry remembers a nervous, nameless traveler who bought the blank book about a month ago.

faq.q: How does this connect to Sven's farm?
faq.answer: The book was salvaged from Sven Yorgen’s destroyed farm in southern Duskwood. It was left behind after a murderous raid wiped out his family.

faq.q: Where does the investigation lead next?
faq.answer: The search continues at Darkshire’s Scarlet Raven Tavern. Someone there may know where the nervous stranger stayed or whom he spoke with.
Daltry is helping identify a buyer from his ordinary book sales. Nothing in the exchange suggests he is personally threatened.

angles.text: For the Alliance, tracing who supplied and aided the necromancers in Duskwood matters to Darkshire’s safety and justice for slaughtered frontier homesteaders.
As a rogue, you know purchase records and a merchant’s memory can help track a nervous target through town.
